model.name: repoManage.deleteRemovable
model.description: From the repo manage panel, a DYNAMIC (user-added) repo can be deleted: it is removed from the RepoRegistry (RepoRegistry.unregister, pure-mechanism dynamic-only) and disappears from the repo selector. A BUILTIN (rawbin, oosh) is NEVER removable (no delete affordance; unregister no-ops/rejects a builtin key). V1 read-auth only (no admin-key; D4 requireAdmin stays deferred, R30.48). Server mechanism REUSES the built RepoRegistry.unregister (Impl 559b508b); the remaining build is UI wiring (delete button -> unregister), which holds for PO green-light.
